perfil: Cutting through her enemies with her spear of thunder, Laru is a flash darting across the battlefield. Here, her free spirit is out in full force.

habilidades.b: Swings the lance to attack the target repeatedly.

tpl.s: Wields the lance to launch consecutive attacks. Strike 1: ⟦0⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 2: ⟦1⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 3: ⟦2⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 4: ⟦3⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG. Strike 5: ⟦4⟧ and ⟦5⟧ of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG.

Divine Thunderquake (Support Skill) can trigger ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩ and summon a Thunderbolt, dealing ⟪0⟫ of ATK as Lux Mark DMG.

builds.d: A build that generates multiple types of lightning to deal DMG over time after casting a skill.
A build that increases the number of skill hits and deals DMG multiple times.

l.b: After casting the Main Skill, creates a Thunder Domain that deals DMG over time.
l.s: After casting Thunderflare Strike (Main Skill), creates a Thunder Domain, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Lux Skill DMG every ⟦1⟧s for a total of 10s.

l.b: The laser inflicts Shock on targets. When attacking Shocked targets, deals additional DMG.
l.s: The laser inflicts Shock on targets for 10s. When dealing damage to Shocked targets, deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as Lux Skill DMG. With the 20th hit, deals ⟦1⟧ as AoE Lux Skill DMG and removes Shock.

l.b: After launching a horizontal sweep with the Main Skill, pulls in targets and deals DMG over time.
l.s: Each of Thunderflare Strike (Main Skill)'s horizontal sweep slices through space, pulling in targets and dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Lux Skill DMG every 0.5s for 5s.

l.b: After casting the Main Skill, increases Laru's ATK SPD and Auto Attack DMG.
l.s: After casting Thunderflare Strike (Main Skill), increases ATK SPD by 30% and Auto Attack DMG by ⟦0⟧, lasting for 10s.

l.b: Increases Laru's Skill DMG dealt to targets over time.
l.s: Increases Laru's Skill DMG dealt to targets by ⟦0⟧ for 2s, stacking up to 20 times.

l.b: Hold the Main Skill button to launch more horizontal sweeps.
l.s: When casting Thunderflare Strike (Main Skill), hold the button to launch 3 horizontal sweeps, dealing ⟦0⟧/⟦1⟧/⟦2⟧ as AoE Lux Skill DMG.

l.b: Each of the Main Skill's horizontal sweep increases the next laser beam's DMG.
l.s: Each of Thunderflare Strike (Main Skill)'s horizontal sweep increases the next laser beam's Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧. After 3 increments, the next laser beam will last for 3s, dealing ⟦1⟧ of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG. While the laser is active, Laru gains Super Armor, increasing her DEF by 500.

l.b: When the Main Skill triggers a ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, summons Chain Lightning to attack nearby targets.
l.s: When Thunderflare Strike (Main Skill) triggers a ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, summons Chain Lightning to attack up to 4 nearby targets, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Lux Skill DMG. This effect can only be triggered 3 times per second.

l.b: When Laru's Auto Attack deals DMG to a target inflicted with ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, increases the Skill DMG of her next Main Skill.
l.s: When Laru's Auto Attack deals DMG to a target inflicted with ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, increases the Skill DMG of her next Main Skill by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 8 times.

l.b: When the horizontal sweep hits a target, increases the laser's DMG dealt to the target.
l.s: When the horizontal sweep of the Main Skill hits a target, increases the laser's Skill DMG to the target by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, up to 5 stacks.

l.b: Laru deals DMG when her dash is interrupted.
l.s: After Laru dashes for over 2 sec, interrupting the dash deals ⟦0⟧ as AoE Lux Skill DMG. This effect can only be triggered once every 10s.

l.b: When Laru deals DMG to a boss target, increases her ATK.
l.s: When Laru deals DMG to a boss target, increases her ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 30s. This effect can only be triggered once per boss fight.

l.b: When the Main Skill triggers ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, increases the Ultimate DMG.
l.s: When Thunderflare Strike (Main Skill) triggers ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, increases Ultimate DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 20s, stacking up to 50 times.

l.b: The lance from the Ultimate deals DMG over time.
l.s: When casting Thunderfall Thrust, throws a lance into the ground, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Lux Ultimate DMG every 0.5s for a total of 10s.

l.b: When the Ultimate hits an elite or higher-tier target, increases its DMG. Also grants Laru Energy.
l.s: When Thunderfall Thrust hits an elite or higher-tier target, increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by the Ultimate by ⟦0⟧. Also grants Laru 5 Energy.

l.b: Each time the Ultimate hits a different target, increases ATK.
l.s: Each time Thunderfall Thrust (Ultimate) hits a different target, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, up to 5 stacks.

builds.d: A build that generates a large number of continuously erupting light pillars.
A build that allows light pillars to strike enemies with greater precision.

l.b: Thunder Domain will deal DMG over time.
l.s: Thunder Domain erupts for 1s, dealing ⟦0⟧ as Lux Skill DMG every 0.3s.

l.b: While the Support Skill is active, creates more Thunder Domains and increases their DMG.
l.s: While Divine Thunderquake (Support Skill) is active, creates ⟦0⟧ additional Thunder Domains and increases their Skill DMG by ⟦1⟧.

l.b: When the Support Skill ends, deals constant DMG to the targets near the main Trekker.
l.s: When Divine Thunderquake (Support Skill) ends, deals ⟦0⟧ as Lux Skill DMG to the targets near the main Trekker every 0.3s for a total of 6s.

l.b: Increases the Thunder Domain's DMG to the same target over time.
l.s: When Thunder Domain deals damage to a target, increases its Skill DMG to that target by ⟦0⟧, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: Thunder Domain can knock targets into the air. Also increases its DMG to airborne targets.
l.s: Thunder Domain can knock targets into the air. Also increases its Skill DMG to airborne targets by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The center of the Thunder Domain deals additional DMG.
l.s: The center of the Thunder Domain deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as Lux Skill DMG to the target.  While the Thunder Domain erupts, dealing an additional ⟦1⟧ as Lux Skill DMG every 0.3s.

l.b: Creates a Thunder Domain at the target's location and increases its DMG.
l.s: Always creates a Thunder Domain at the target's location and increases Skill DMG dealt by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When casting the Support Skill, deals additional DMG. While the Support Skill is active, deals additional DMG constantly.
l.s: When casting Divine Thunderquake (Support Skill), deals an additional ⟦0⟧ as AoE Lux Skill DMG. While infusing light energy, deals ⟦1⟧ as AoE Lux Skill DMG constantly.

l.b: Each time the Support Skill hits a different target, the Skill DMG is increased.
l.s: While Divine Thunderquake (Support Skill) is active, each time Laru hits a different target with the Support Skill, the Skill DMG dealt by that Support Skill is increased by ⟦0⟧, up to 6 stacks.

l.b: After a squadmate casts a Main Skill, increases the DMG of Laru's next Support Skill.
l.s: After a squadmate casts a Main Skill, increases the Skill DMG of Laru's next Support Skill, Divine Thunderquake, by ⟦0⟧, stacking up to 5 times.

l.b: Increases the Skill DMG of Lux Trekkers.
l.s: Increases the Skill DMG of Lux Trekkers by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: When the Support Skill triggers a ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, increases Skill DMG.
l.s: When Divine Thunderquake (Support Skill) triggers a ⟨Lux Mark: Radiance⟩, increases Skill DMG by ⟦0⟧ for 12s, up to 12 stacks.

l.b: Increases Laru's ATK.
l.s: Increases Laru's ATK by ⟦0⟧.

l.b: The lance from the Ultimate deals DMG over time.
l.s: When casting Thunderfall Thrust, throws a lance into the ground, dealing ⟦0⟧ as AoE Lux Ultimate DMG every 0.5s for a total of 10s.

l.b: When the Ultimate hits an elite or higher-tier target, increases its DMG. Also grants Laru Energy.
l.s: When Thunderfall Thrust hits an elite or higher-tier target, increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by the Ultimate by ⟦0⟧. Also grants Laru 5 Energy.

l.b: Each time the Ultimate hits a different target, increases ATK.
l.s: Each time Thunderfall Thrust (Ultimate) hits a different target, increases ATK by ⟦0⟧ for 15s, up to 5 stacks.
